notes.title: Version 1.0.6c
notes.content:
[h2]Big Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a misplaced tile in "The Looking Glass"
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.6b
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the moving platforms not killing the player in places when they should.
[*] Fixed the timer not resetting if you switch to a different level using the notebook from inside a level.
[*] Fixed the timer resetting post-death in the first room of "Forgotten Archives" after you punch one of the keys that persist through death.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.6a
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed moving platforms crushing the player when moving away from the player.
[*] Fixed the launched platform in the final room of "Den of Pixies" from getting stuck on the wall.
[*] Fixed a visual bug in "Throne Room" during the cutscene in the second room.
[*] Fixed the arrows on frozen blocks from not disappearing.
[*] Fixed the world 5 slider from not crushing the player in situations where it should.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.6
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the camera continuing to move after completing a level in a room with X axis camera scroll limits.
[*] Fixed the camera keeping the X axis scroll limits through door transitions if the player died in the room with the scroll limits.
[*] Fixed an issue causing certain screen transitions to not be rendered.
[*] Fixed a physics bug with wall kicks, where the force from the wall kick was dependent on frame rate.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.5a
notes.content:
[h2]QOL Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] The "highlight mouse cursor" key will no longer highlight the cursor when on the title screen or world map, as it's not needed there.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.5
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a linux exclusive issue with the world 2 boss fight, where Vivi would visually be locked in the middle of the screen.
[/list]

[h2]QOL Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new setting to the controls to highlight the position of the mouse cursor, as it's easy to lose track of it.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.4c
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*]Fixed text smudging issues on the pause menu and level complete screens.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.4b
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed some text that was smeared in the pause menu's notebook.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.4a
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug introduced in the previous update, where certain objects which give momentum to the player would still provide momentum after you stop interacting with them.
[*] Fixed text smudging on the level name shown in the pause menu on the Linux build.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.4
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issues with the linux build only showing a black screen.
[*] Fixed issues with the firework block not detecting the fist within the first 0.1 seconds of the fist being held.
[*] Fixed issues with the world 3 Boss sliding blocks not being punched in edge cases.
[*] Fixed the launched blocks from getting stuck to walls in Frostbite.
[/list]

[h2]QOL Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new option to the accessibility menu to modify the force the fist will apply to objects.
[*] Added the ability to queue another move on a world 3 boss sliding block within a half second of it hitting a wall.
[*] Made the buffer duration for world 1 sliders slightly larger.
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] Text on the linux build is occasionally smudged.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.3c
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed collision issues with world 1 launched platforms and walls.
[*] Fixed falling out of bubbles in the final boss blue heart section.
[*] Fixed the final bubble in 5-3 from losing momentum by colliding with the ground.
[/list]

[h2]QOL Improvements:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Moved the final mirror of 5-3 one tile to the left.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.3b
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed collision issues with world 4 launched platforms and walls.
[*] Fixed issues with ladders in the final boss' blue heart section.
[*] Fixed movement inconsistencies with holding the jump button in the final boss' blue heart section.
[/list]

[h2]QOL Improvements:[/h2]

[list]
[*] With Accessibility mode's invulnerability, World 2 vinebombs won't detonate on hazards.
[*] With Accessibility mode's invulnerability, hive bombs won't detonate on briars or the player.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.3a
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a game breaking bug preventing the final boss from being beaten
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.3
notes.content:
[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed inconsistencies with sliding blocks not always being punched.
[*] Fixed the sides of launching platforms from occasionally killing the player at times when they should not.
[*] Fixed rebound inputs from not working in a section during the final boss.
[*] Fixed rebinding "Move Fist" from causing inconsistent inputs required to navigate menus.
[*] fixed the map music from not unlocking in the radio.
[*] Fixed a specific corner in "The Caves" from clipping the player through a wall.
[*] Fixed a specific corner in "Nyctophobia" from clipping the player trough a wall.
[/list]

[h2]QOL changes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] The speedrun time listed in the notebook will now be highlighted if it was completed in a single session.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.2
notes.content: Added a small room to The Five Mile Spire to assist in collecting a hidden coin.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.content: Added a new room to "Fist Fight". This room should teach the players that they can hold the momentum from a player-punch-block as long as the mouse is held even if the block moves off screen, which is required knowledge for the following room.
